To address the severe wrong_bypass mistakes on 605.mcf_s-1644B and 619.lbm_s-2677B, the policy must change how it decides to bypass fills, perhaps by adding a confidence counter to the state to remember which signatures actually see reuse before resident lines. To fix should_bypass on 627.cam4_s-573B, the insertion decision needs to better identify lines that will never be reused. For the kept_dead mistakes on 657.xz_s-2302B, the victim selection must age lines more aggressively to evict them once their reuse window passes. A new word could be declared to express a custom history hash function or a specific confidence threshold for bypassing, allowing the policy to better separate useful fills from dead ones in a way the base vocabulary cannot.
